title: Mossbrook
experiment: Simon Willison's Emberwick prompt sequence (simonwillison.net/2026/Oct/28/vibe-game-development/), all 4 prompts, rebuilt from scratch
author: Claude Opus 5.5, gamecraft session 2026-10-31
prompts: 1. A three.js engine demo for an angled top-down RPG: player walks a fantasy village with one or two companions; entering a building turns the camera-side wall transparent.
2. Add NPCs, plenty of furniture, several building types, some with an upstairs.
3. Make the landscape not flat; give two buildings basements joined by a tunnel; add a rocky mountain with a cave holding a sleeping troll.
4. Turn it into an actual game: four times the playable area, fun mechanics, a plot that is not too cliche with twists, a magic system, make it really good.
